board: Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense, Arduino mbed core

requirements.requirement: The on-board LED (pin D13) is off immediately after the board resets or powers up.
Each press of the button on pin D2 toggles the LED: the first press turns it on, the next press turns it off, and so on.
The LED changes state within 20 ms of a valid button press, so the user notices no delay.
A single physical button press toggles the LED exactly once, even though the contacts bounce.
On every toggle, the board prints the new LED state, either ON or OFF, on its own line over Serial1 at 9600 baud.
The code uses the Serial1 object (pins D0/D1) configured at 9600 baud for the state messages, not the USB Serial port.
The code configures pin D2 as INPUT_PULLUP to read the button, since there is no external resistor.
